subject: Draft MAP + proposed procurement/signature deadlines for OliveTech
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@olivetech.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP + proposed procurement/signature deadlines for OliveTech

Hi Samir — thanks again for the call today. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out milestones, owners, and a suggested target close date so procurement and legal can plan resources. High level:

Attachments: OliveTech-MAP-draft-v1.pdf; OliveTech-SOW-redline-template.docx

Key milestones (proposed):
- Pilot setup & data ingestion (OliveTech IT / Redwood SE) — target complete: 2/6/2026
- Pilot validation & success criteria sign-off (OliveTech Product / Redwood Solutions) — target complete: 2/13/2026
- Procurement internal approval & PO issuance (OliveTech Procurement) — target complete: 2/19/2026
- Legal review & contract redlines (OliveTech Legal / Redwood Legal) — target complete: 2/23/2026
- Contract signature (final) — target: 2/26/2026 ("target close date")

Proposed responsibilities (first-pass):
- OliveTech: provide sample data, run pilot validation, submit procurement packet
- Redwood: provide sandbox environment and dedicated SE support during pilot, produce SOW and final contract

Dependencies and risks:
- Procurement blackout windows (if any) could shift the signature date — please flag dates where procurement is unavailable.
- Legal redlines longer than two business days will push signature out — we can offer a prioritized turnaround if needed.

Ask from you: please review the attached MAP and indicate: 1) whether the target close date 2/26 is feasible, 2) any procurement/finance calendar constraints we should accommodate, and 3) who should be listed as the procurement/PO owner (name + email) so we can update the MAP.

If it's helpful, Grace is happy to run a 30-min kickoff with your technical stakeholders later this week.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

--

From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@olivetech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Megan Lee <megan.lee@olivetech.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + proposed procurement/signature deadlines for OliveTech

Rishi — thanks for the recap and for putting the MAP together. A few notes from procurement and legal on our side: 

1) Procurement calendar constraints:
- We have an internal budget review week the week of Feb 22 — 26 where procurement is light on capacity. If possible we need contract signature before that week (ideally by Feb 19) so finance can process PO and payment within the quarter.

2) Legal review timeline:
- Our GC can do a 48-hour turnaround on standard SaaS contracts but will need additional time if there are bespoke indemnity or data processing clauses.

3) Immediate asks from OliveTech: 
- Please provide the SOW with line-item pricing (we did not see explicit pricing in the draft MAP). We need that to complete the PO.
- Can Redwood confirm that the pilot environment will have SOC 2 controls in place (or provide SOC 2 report)?

I've attached our procurement timeline for reference.

Tentative decision from my side: we can aim for signature on 2026-02-19 if Redwood can: 1) provide the line-item SOW by 2026-02-05, and 2) commit to a 48-hour legal turnaround on standard contract terms. If those two conditions are met, procurement will prioritize the PO so we can hit 2/19.

Who should I expect to get the redlines back from? Also, please add my procurement lead in the MAP: Megan Lee <megan.lee@olivetech.com> as PO owner.

Thanks —
Samir Rao
Head of Product Operations, OliveTech
samir.rao@olivetech.com

--
[Attachment: OliveTech-Procurement-Timeline.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Draft MAP + proposed procurement/signature deadlines for OliveTech

Lauren / Grace — forwarding Samir's procurement notes. Short summary and proposed internal actions: 

Summary from customer:
- OliveTech can sign by 2026-02-19 if we deliver: (A) detailed SOW with line-item pricing by 2026-02-05, and (B) 48-hour legal turnaround on standard terms. Procurement has budget week the week of Feb 22-26 (they want signature before then).

Proposed Redwood actions:
1) Grace: can you prioritize SOW line-item by Feb 5? If needed I can draft the pricing matrix and you can validate the technical scope.
2) Lauren: can we get legal to agree to a 48-hour SLA on redlines for this deal? If yes, do we have any required internal approvals for an expedited turnaround (e.g., credit checks, revenue recognition impacts)?
3) I'll update the MAP (v2) to reflect a target close date of 2026-02-19 and list Megan Lee as procurement owner. I'll also call Samir to confirm timelines.

I attached an updated MAP that reflects Samir's preference (MAP v2). I'll also include a line-item SOW template prefilled with our standard pricing so Grace can tweak.

Thanks —
Rishi

Hi Samir / Megan — following up after our internal alignment. Per your ask, we've updated the MAP and SOW timelines and can commit to the deliverables below: 

Agreed milestones (finalized):
- SOW (line-item pricing) delivered by Redwood: 2026-02-05 (Grace owner)
- Pilot environment live: 2026-02-06 (Redwood SE + OliveTech IT)
- Pilot validation sign-off: 2026-02-13 (OliveTech Product)
- Legal redlines returned: within 48 hours of receipt (Redwood Legal + OliveTech Legal)
- Procurement/contract signature (target close): 2026-02-19 (OliveTech Procurement / Redwood Sales)

Owners:
- OliveTech PO owner: Megan Lee <megan.lee@olivetech.com>
- Redwood SOW owner: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
- Redwood legal contact: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Next steps (this week):
1) Grace will send the line-item SOW draft to Samir & Megan by 2026-02-05.
2) Lauren will confirm legal's 48-hour SLA and escalate if any unusual redlines appear.
3) Rishi to add agreed dates to HubSpot and share DocuSign link for signature once legal is complete.

Samir — please confirm that the 2/19 signature target works for you and that Megan is the correct procurement owner. If anything above needs adjusting, let me know and we'll update the MAP immediately.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot started.

Best,
